backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a social media marketing service platform with access control, user profiles, services (followers/likes/views for Facebook/Instagram/YouTube/TikTok), cart items, orders, and testimonials with CRUD operations and admin/user authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three completed features: removing login button from Header, removing smmourprice logo from Footer/Header/Hero, and adding IBAZEX logo replacements across those components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend React components describing an Arabic RTL e-commerce platform for social media services with cart, checkout, admin dashboard, service management, and IBAZEX branding throughout.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes defining colors for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, borders, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point configured for Arabic RTL layout with SMM Ourprice title, favicon, Inter font preload, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with TanStack Router setup defining routes for home (Hero), services, and admin dashboard with Layout wrapper containing Header/Footer/ProfileSetupDialog, ThemeProvider, and CartProvider.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: Authentication gate component that checks if user is logged in and has admin privileges, showing login prompt or access denied message if requirements aren't met before rendering admin children.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminDashb: Main admin dashboard with tabbed interface for overview, services management, orders table, and testimonials management sections, displaying user greeting from profile data.
frontend/src/components/admin/DashboardO: Admin dashboard overview component displaying three metric cards (total orders, pending orders, total revenue) and a recent activity list of the latest 5 orders with Arabic labels.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrdersTabl: Admin orders table component that displays all customer orders in a table with columns for order ID, customer info, items, total, and status, allowing admins to update order status via a dropdown.
frontend/src/components/admin/ServiceMan: Admin service management component with a table of services and dialogs for adding new services and editing service prices, supporting platform/service type selection and availability toggling.
frontend/src/components/admin/Testimonia: Admin testimonial management component displaying a table of customer testimonials with a dialog to add new testimonials including customer name, service type, rating (1-5 stars), and testimonial text.
frontend/src/components/Cart.tsx: Shopping cart component (content truncated in source).
frontend/src/components/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page component (content truncated in source).
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Arabic RTL footer with IBAZEX logo, quick links navigation, social media icons (Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp), contact details, and copyright notice with Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with IBAZEX logo and Arabic navigation links (home, services, admin) without authentication UI, using TanStack Router Link components with active state styling.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section component displaying the IBAZEX logo, Arabic tagline about social media marketing services, WhatsApp contact info, and feature cards for followers, likes, and views with animated entrance effects.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their full name to complete account setup, with form validation and mutation handling via useSaveCallerUserProfile hook.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Card component displaying a social media service with platform/service type icons, pricing calculator, quantity input, and order dialog that collects username/links before generating a WhatsApp URL for order placement.
frontend/src/components/ServicesPage.tsx: Services listing page with platform filter tabs (all, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok) that displays available services in a responsive grid using ServiceCard components.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Testimonials section component that fetches and displays customer reviews in a grid layout with star ratings, service type badges, and customer names.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance using Internet Identity authentication, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCart.tsx: React context and hook for managing shopping cart state, providing functions to add/remove items, update quantities, clear cart, and calculate totals with price per 1000 units.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity storage, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for backend operations including services, orders, testimonials, and user profiles with mutations for CRUD operations and automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, RTL layout for Arabic text, and custom animation utilities (fadeIn, slideInFromBottom, zoomIn).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts: Generates WhatsApp URLs with pre-filled Arabic messages containing service order details (platform, service type, quantity, price, and customer information).
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration with custom color scheme, typography, container queries, animations, and Inter font family with RTL support.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking IBAZEX branding changes, removal of login functionality, Arabic interface requirements, and image specifications for logos.
